content: The wife sought half of the funds withdrawn by the husband from a joint account, as well as a share in his professional SRL. The Court ruled that earnings from a spouse's separate activity are personal until dissolution; if consumed before the community ends, the other spouse has no right to an accounting or reimbursement. Furthermore, acquiring stock shares in an SRL constitutes a credit position rather than a real right, thus excluding it from the legal community. Finally, vehicles separately titled and used exclusively by each spouse are considered personal assets under Art. 179(c) CC and are excluded from division.
